source_contract: Original Atlas comparison status enum and native statuses.json; DERIVED_VOCABULARY is an index-file exclusion list, not permission to invent status codes.
rules: Use only the ten comparison_statuses. tight, exact_zero, gap, fully_optimal and custom aliases are not comparison codes. Unknown inherited codes require an explicit reviewed correction, never automatic alias guessing.

optimal applies within one comparison's precise declared contract and regime. fully_optimal is only a summary badge iff all registered comparisons are optimal, under scope documented_comparison_domain; it does not certify the whole parameter domain or exhaustive literature.

Exact zero/one cost and saturation are additional attributes, not new main codes. Optional status.attributes.exact_cost is a nonnegative integer on an optimal comparison; saturation is boolean. exact_cost=0 requires ratio_applicable=false. A zero-cost branch has no positive multiplicative ratio and never 0/0.

missing_lower/upper/both have exactly their declared missing sides. Other scalar comparison codes have none. joint_budget_unclosed may list achievable_budget and/or necessary_resource_constraint, including an empty list when no side is declared missing.

summary comparison_count and status_counts equal the actual comparisons; missing_sides is their exact union; gap_classes contains exactly the three quantified-gap classes actually present, never optimal/tight/missing-side codes.

summary special_statuses is exactly the present special statuses. badges contains bounds_missing iff the missing-side union is nonempty; fully_optimal iff every comparison is optimal. Gap badges refer only to present gaps and include the highest priority gap (polynomial, other quantified, logarithmic). Additional present gap badges are permitted. Labels must be nonempty; ordering and source-faithful display qualifiers do not change identity.

A formula, source read, guarded envelope and scientific review are still required for mathematical claims. Status validation supplies no proof, evidence-read credit or inherited approval. Do not change a scientific code merely to satisfy taxonomy.

The main scientific status exists only at top-level comparisons[].status and its aggregate summary_status. Regimes, nested comparison regimes and bracket objects must not introduce another status field. Workflow statuses inside joint_analysis remain separate and are not comparison codes.
When gap_causes is present, it is a unique list drawn from the six registered reasons. It is optional and grants neither optimality nor proof or literature-completeness credit.
